lens: Skeptic. Fabrics compared at matched physical scale with the 0.43 m seat width as the ruler: q15 at x0.63 against y_47300 at x1.0, e4 at x0.81 against y_47306, and q16 at x1.0 against y_47301. Measured: box mean, B/R, luminance p10/p50/p90, column CV, column-profile FFT, fleck coverage (pixels above 1.4x the median) with fleck/ground L and colours, white-pixel counts for the shell sliver. The same boxes as w17 were rerun on rc8/sc8 and rc9/sc9 side by side. Official photos decide colour; in-flight photos decide geometry (no new downloads). Renders are of 9cf4598 (rc9 / sc9). Scratch files are in /tmp/claude-0/rater18A/ (st.py, fl.py, cmp1.png, tick.png, sheet0.png, sheet1.png).

priorIssues.issue: w17a-1 / w16a-2 tick columns break into speckle at row distance
priorIssues.evidence: q15 seats 1/3 at x0.63: colCV 0.079/0.069 (w17 0.077/0.062) vs y_47300 0.241/0.236; p10/p50 0.57 vs 0.45/0.43. Column-profile FFT at matched scale: render peak period 3.5 px with relative amplitude 0.013; photo period 4.0 px, amplitude 0.096 (7x stronger). tick.png: at native q15 resolution the render does show columns now (the 2x profile is visible), but they are broken and slightly irregular, and they vanish at x0.63. Close up the columns are now stronger than the photo's (e4 tick back colCV 0.183 vs y_47306 0.094), so the problem is at distance and with the column pitch, not with the tile contrast.

issues.title: Headrest cover now too dark at every angle except head-on (lost the silver-grey grazing sheen)
issues.evidence: q16 near cover L36 B/R 1.99 vs y_47301 L65 B/R 1.60; q16 row 2 L46 vs L75 (w17 64); e4 L36 vs y_47306 L83; y_47303 covers L118 B/R 1.49. Head-on q15 is now right (L40-50 vs 35-62). The real cover is dark head-on and silver at grazing angles, which is a sheen / Fresnel effect, not an albedo.
issues.fix: Keep yCover albedo #2a2f45 but give it a grazing sheen: either a cloth/sheen lobe (Charlie or velvet, sheen colour ~#8a90a8, strength ~0.5), or the leather layer at r ~0.45 with Fresnel F90 lifted so that at 60-75 deg from normal the cover reaches L 65-85. Check that q15 head-on stays at L40-50 and q16 near cover reaches L60-70. Also still add the hem stitch ~1.5 cm above the lower edge, ~4 mm edge thickness and the wing logo at the lower right (y_47306).

issues.title: Tick columns still wash out at row distance (fourth round); pitch too fine
issues.evidence: q15 seats 1/3 at x0.63: colCV 0.079/0.069 vs 0.24; p10/p50 0.57 vs 0.44; FFT amplitude at the column frequency 0.013 vs 0.096. The render's column pitch is ~11 mm (39 columns over 0.43 m), the photo's ~13 mm (32 columns). At q15 distance 11 mm sits right at the mip's cut-off and averages out. The 2x profile only made the close-ups too strong (e4 colCV 0.18 vs 0.09).
issues.fix: make_swatches.py synth_y_tick: widen the column pitch ~20 % (to ~13 mm), make each dark channel a continuous 2-texel line ~30 % darker than the ground (rather than strengthening the pale strokes), and halve the 2x profile back to ~1.3x so the close-ups stay near colCV 0.10. If it still fades, apply a mip bias of about -0.7 on the tick layer (see from_econ.md). Target q15 colCV >= 0.15 and p10/p50 <= 0.50.

issues.title: Petal fleck fades further at row distance; still round dots
issues.evidence: q15 coverage 0.13 vs 0.21 (w17 0.16), fleck/ground 1.68 vs 2.23 (w17 1.78), fleck B/R 2.10 vs 1.62. The finer cores shrank below the mip footprint, so the neutral tint never reaches the screen at distance. Close up, the tint is now about right (B/R 1.46 vs 1.27).
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_fleck: keep the neutral core tint, but make each fleck ~1.4x larger in area and elongated (~1.6:1 at random angles, +/-40 % size spread) rather than finer, with ~25 % fewer flecks so close-up coverage drops from 0.27 to ~0.20 while row-distance coverage rises to ~0.18-0.21. Raise the core L ~10 %. Target q15 fleck/ground >= 2.0 and fleck B/R <= 1.8.

issues.title: Armrest: separate rear post still opens a loop under the pad
issues.evidence: e7 / e1: the flat J is right, but a slim post from the pivot to the pad rear leaves a triangular opening. y_47303 shows one closed C moulding, with no second member.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: drop the rear post, or merge it into the J's lower end as a short fillet (<= 4 cm tall).

issues.title: Seat pans all tick; y_47300 shows mosaic pans on some seats
issues.evidence: e1 / e7: all pans tick. In y_47300 seats 3/4 are mosaic, and in y_47303 the pans are fleck.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js econPan: cycle the pan weave independently (tick / mosaic / fleck) over the 6-seat cycle.

issues.title: Pillow has no seam or pinched corners
issues.fix: Add a 4 mm piping seam around the pillow's perimeter and pinch the four corners ~1 cm.

issues.title: No lower-bezel indicator dots on the screen

issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: add 4-5 small dark-grey dots, ~4 mm, centred on the lower bezel.

issues.title: Fabric smears at grazing angles on the back sides
issues.evidence: q18 left back side: a blurred blue wash; in y_47305 the side weave stays crisp.
issues.fix: Enable EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic (8x) on the fabric layers. Not scored.
